library.name: React
library.description: React is installed from npm (pinned in package-lock.json) and compiled together with the plugin's own TypeScript sources (js/src) into the prebuilt authoring editor bundle js/vendor/react/editor.bundle.js, used on Moodle versions without a native React runtime. The declaration points at the js/vendor/react directory, which always exists in a checkout and documents the bundle, rather than at a build artefact under amd/build/, which moodle-plugin-ci wipes before re-running Grunt. Provenance and reproducible build steps: js/vendor/react/readme_moodle.txt.

library.name: ReactDOM
library.description: ReactDOM is bundled into the prebuilt authoring editor bundle together with React (see the React entry for build details and js/vendor/react/readme_moodle.txt for provenance).

library.name: Scheduler
library.description: Scheduler (a ReactDOM runtime dependency) is bundled into the prebuilt authoring editor bundle together with React and ReactDOM.
